about: launch redesign copy ledger (PLAN LD32, R29): the 120 items of the copy audit (docs/design/launch-redesign-mock/data/copy_audit.json, live build 20261020.2), each with its page, its owning milestone (LD3), its disposition, the shipped text or pattern (a regex over the page's text, tips included; numbers as \d), the replaced text that must be gone, and for adapted and not-applied one reason code from the closed set. Created in M2; each milestone finalizes its own entries; M8 closes it. Closed in the final copy pass (F1, 2026-10-21): no pending entry. `gates` records, per page, the SC5 gate the orchestrator's speed-mode decision adjusts — audit words_visible_after + the words an honesty pin or owner decision D7 kept (itemized; basis audit = the audit's own counts, measured = counted on the shipped markup, ceiling = at most the audit's words_before − words_after for an adapted element not measured here) + 10%, rounded up. A page with any ceiling item carries `gateCeiling` until the owner-tier run on the real build counts those elements; the playbooks tab keeps its own gate (680).
